trans.sense: A disease characterized by purulent skin eruptions that may leave pockmark — see also smallpox, variola

glosses: A disease characterized by skin eruptions (especially purulent ones) that may leave pockmarks.

examples.text: a pox on all their houses
A pox on him, he's a cat still.
